propositions: Five function-scoped git/rebar fixture builders repeatedly construct equivalent virgin topologies from scratch for each test consumer, contributing 103+ aggregate worker-seconds across top modules in Verify run 31846417650.
Runtime measurements with cProfile and isolated copies demonstrate setup dominates test-body work, with real-build versus copy ratios of 12x to 23x across the five fixture families.

Django/Rails/GitLab OSS precedents and closed tickets peculiar-calmy-bubblefish and adored-duskish-kissingbug establish consensus that session-scoped templates with per-test isolation are safe for proven-equivalent fixtures while preserving from-scratch initialization contracts.

The clone_topology_template helper initially copied asymmetric .opcert-key/.pub verbatim instead of reminting per-environment identity, causing all cloned stores to share private signing authority despite distinct environment principals.

Repair in commit 3bf9b2b2c4 introduces behavioral isolation sentinels and migrates only proven-equivalent fixtures, reducing 260 >1s fixture_setup spans to zero in the five target modules while preserving all 125 affected tests and initialization/recovery contracts.
